type Getter = { get x(): number };
type Field = { x: number };
type Wide = { get x(): number; set x(value: number | string) };
type Fixed = { readonly x: number };
const a: Getter & Field = { x: 1 };
a.x = 2;
const b: Field & Getter = { x: 1 };
b.x = 3;
const c: Wide & Field = { x: 1 };
c.x = "s";
c.x = 4;
const d: Fixed & Getter = { x: 1 };
d.x = 5;
const e: Getter & Getter = { x: 1 };
e.x = 6;
const f: Wide & Wide = { x: 1 };
f.x = "t";
console.log(a.x, b.x, c.x, d.x, e.x, f.x);
